items.title: PAYDAY 3: Guns Blazin’ Crimebond Now Available!
items.excerpt: The Guns Blazin' Crimebond contains outfits, cosmetics, weapon perks, and, for the first time in PAYDAY 3, dual revolvers and (stealable) dual shotguns.

items.excerpt: Today's update features a new Crimebond, the Feeding Frenzy Heist, Headless Nebula Accounts, Arges Perk Updates, and more!

items.title: PAYDAY 3: Behind the Scenes with Andrej #9
items.excerpt: October is almost over! And Andrej is finally back with another update on what the team has been working on for PAYDAY 3!

items.title: PAYDAY 3: The Future of PAYDAY with Paul – Episode 5
items.excerpt: As we approach the end of the year, Paul is back to share what’s coming in October, November, and December!

items.excerpt: New York has treated Dallas well, but lately, there’s been a lot on his mind. It’s time to reflect, talk it out, and make some changes for the better.
